enunciado: With the BST built from 8, 3, 10, 1, 6, 14, 4, 7, 13 show the pre-order, in-order and post-order traversals.
objetivos: Relate each traversal to its uses
pistas: Pre-order: root, left, right (useful to copy the tree).
Post-order: left, right, root (useful to free or evaluate).
Only the place where the root is printed changes.
